name: Visual search on a screen
description: 8 simulated participants look for an orange disc among distractors, 12 trials each. In easy trials the target pops out; in hard trials it shares a feature with every distractor. 120 samples per second, 1920 × 1080 screen (53 cm wide) at 60 cm. Participant P06 has noisy data. The true fixations are in truth/fixations.csv.
